title: Uqua gas chambers
summary: Solve each changing gas-chamber lock using the precise clue and the correct key alone.
overview: Solve each changing gas-chamber lock using the precise clue and the correct key alone.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Have the definite clue recipient call the key immediately and keep other key types off the opener.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The chamber begins issuing new lock clues every twenty seconds.
One player receives a definite key clue; another can receive a misleading either-or clue.
At least six non-GM players must stand in the chamber's checked area to open the door.
The opener must carry the correct key and none of the other three key types. A wrong attempt summons a jet flame and starts a one-minute reset.
Success permanently opens that chamber for the expedition's saved completion window and releases guards beyond it.

notes: Approval E386. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
